Make SagaDrive Core §5.7 / §8.3 / §10 item mechanics an executable, UI-independent rules kernel slice under `src/domains/rules/sagadrive/items/**`, so Inventory v2 and the items domain consume one public API without competing formula or type copies.

- Item domain taxonomy (#134) on branch base
- Inventory v2 domain + Core catalog (36 archetypes)
- Architecture boundary check (#94) active

- [x] Mismatched Schutz/Mindeststärke pairs fail closed

- [x] `minimumStrength` remains an equip prerequisite concern (ownership unchanged)
